title: maple.config.json
description: Per-project config read by every maple-standard plugin command/hook. Canonical shape per docs/standard-architecture.md (project/repo/worktrees/docs/ci/lint/sizeCaps/errorTracker/loops), plus plugin-specific operational extensions nested under the same canonical top-level blocks (never a competing top-level block — see plugin/README.md 'Schema reconciliation'). Every key is optional except project.name/project.slug; omitted keys fall back to documented defaults.

root.description: Absolute, or relative to the repo root. Default ".worktrees" — inside the repo, gitignored (maple-start self-heals the .gitignore entry).

ttlSeconds.description: DEPRECATED and ignored since D066: a land lock is never stolen from a live pid, so there is no TTL. Still accepted so existing configs validate.

ephemeralPaths.description: plugin extension — doc-relative paths (under docs.root) that own no code and so are exempt from the drift gate's point-to-code anchor check, e.g. a session-state folder. Default [].

stack.description: Isolated throwaway Supabase stack for the heavy tier (D071). portBase enables it: ports portBase..portBase+9 are the stack's own block.

heavyCarryOver.description: Opt-in HEAVY STAMP CARRY-OVER (D077): `gate-cli carry` may give HEAD a heavy-pass record carried from the nearest first-parent ancestor with a real green heavy run when the diff between them is only in-place edits of the listed top-level .json files (and, for maple.config.json, scalar changes at listed keys). Every reader re-verifies the carry from git; the predeploy gate still runs on HEAD; no gate debt is paid. Authoritative validation: plugin/scripts/gate/heavy-carry-rules.mjs.

paths.description: Exact top-level .json file names (no directory, glob, `..` or absolute path; tool manifests such as package.json / tsconfig*.json are refused). Required and non-empty when enabled.

configKeys.description: Key paths in maple.config.json whose scalar value may change: dot-separated keys with array selectors [*], [id=<id>] or [<n>]; exact whole-path match; only under predeploy, never enabled/fastLane/deployGuard/emergency/allowlist/decisions/imageDebt.file, never a command/preset/github/parse/regex/workflow/enabled leaf. Required iff maple.config.json is in paths.

verification.description: The /heal fix-verify ladder (t1-t5) — deliberately namespaced under errorTracker, not ci.tiers, to avoid colliding with the wt-land gate tiers (docs/decisions.md D002-D011 reconciliation, #T11).

toolCalls.description: plugin extension (re-review B2) — plugin/hooks/loop-budget-guard.mjs's own runaway backstop, counting RAW TOOL CALLS (every Bash/Read/Edit/etc. within the cycle). A DIFFERENT UNIT from `turns` (loop iterations, enforced separately by each command's own `budget.mjs check --used $ITER` calls, never by this hook) — do not confuse the two. Default 400, deliberately generous.

weights.description: plugin extension (docs/tasks.md #T8) — loop name -> pick-loop.mjs round-robin weight, default 1 for every enabled loop. Object keys are validated against the loops.enabled name set by validate-config.mjs (JSON Schema alone can't express that cross-check).

cooldownCycles.description: plugin extension (docs/tasks.md #T8) — how many ledger cycles a loop that just reported "quiet" is skipped for by pick-loop.mjs. Default 3; 0 disables cooldown.

sessionCap.description: plugin extension (docs/tasks.md #T8) — /dev-burner's optional global budget (orchestrator step 2). Unset = no session cap; the standing /loop session's own stop mechanism is the only ceiling.

jev.description: plugin extension — Jev (TypeSafe System One) decision-model integration: model routing, skill selection, search decisions, and SubagentStop validation. See plugin/README.md 'Jev' section.

enabled.description: Default true. Every jev.* call still fails open (allow / fall back to sonnet) with no key configured, so leaving this true costs nothing on a project with no TypeSafe key.

credentialTarget.description: OS credential-store target name to try FIRST (plugin/scripts/jev/client.mjs then tries 'Maple-TypeSafe-APIKey', then 'MapleLens-TypeSafe-APIKey'). Default null.

confidenceFloor.description: Default 0.5 — the confidence below which a Jev choice answer is treated as 'don't know' and the caller falls back to its own default. jev-model-routing uses its own separate, higher constant (ladder.mjs ESCALATION_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR, 0.8) for escalating past the default executor — not configurable via this key.

timeoutMs.description: Default 3000 — fail-open budget per Jev call. Deliberately short: these calls run inline in a hook or skill and must never be worth blocking a turn over.

credentialCacheTtlSeconds.description: Default 300 — how long client.mjs's DPAPI-encrypted per-user credential cache stays fresh before the next call re-reads Windows Credential Manager directly. 0 disables the cache.

quality.description: plugin extension — code-quality gates. See plugin/scripts/jev/audit/README.md and docs/decisions.md D051 (gates are canonically owned by the plugin, ported from MapleLens's tools/jev/audit.mjs).

jevAudit.description: Per-function Jev code-quality audit/gate config. Every key optional; an absent block (or enabled:false) means /wt-land and /quality-gate skip the gate entirely. Defaults documented in plugin/scripts/jev/audit/config.mjs.

enabled.description: Default false (opt-in — a fresh adopter should not silently start sending source to a third-party model). maple-land skips the quality-gate landing step entirely when this is false.

slug.description: Namespaces this config's cache/report under .maplelens/audit/<slug>/ (or the plugin's own per-user state dir when that path isn't gitignored). Default: project.slug.

baseBranch.description: Explicit base branch for changed-function scoping. Default: the landing target passed by maple-land, else repo.devBranch, else "main".

denylistPatterns.description: Case-insensitive regex patterns matched against a file path or function name; a match means the function's source is NEVER sent to Jev.

moduleLabels.description: scopeDirs entry -> report heatmap label override, for scopeDirs that would otherwise collapse to the same top-level segment.

thresholds.description: Blocking-rule constants for --gate mode. Uncalibrated (docs/decisions.md D051's porting brief) — env-overridable per constant, see plugin/scripts/jev/audit/config.mjs.

predeploy.description: plugin extension (D060) — the ENFORCED pre-deploy gate. checks[] (command | preset | github), an expiring allowlist, a deploy guard (PreToolUse), an emergency override (default off) and the aggressive live ZAP scan policy. Authoritative validation: plugin/scripts/predeploy/config.mjs. See docs/predeploy-gate.md.

policyRef.description: Decision id the project's policy is recorded under.

allowlist.description: Repo-relative path of the committed allowlist. Default predeploy-allowlist.json.

decisions.description: Repo-relative path of the committed decision-backed (permanent) exceptions file. Default predeploy-decisions.json. Essentials only; every entry needs an existing D### in docs.decisions.

decisionsMaxAgeDays.description: Max age of an entry's `reviewed` date before the gate fails it for re-review. Default 180.

imageDebt.description: Opt-in dated third-party image debt ledger (D063). Our own images (ownImages) can never be listed; every other trivy-image image needs an entry in `file` with owner, plan, due and a snapshot of finding keys. No growth, fails after the due date. Written only by run.mjs --rebaseline-image-debt.

ownImages.description: trivy-image names of OUR images; they must have zero findings.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the committed ledger. Default predeploy-image-debt.json.

runs.description: Retention of the gate's disposable run workspaces under <git-common-dir>/maple/predeploy/runs (D068). Pruned at run end, at every gate/live start, and by `run.mjs prune`.

keep.description: Finished run workspaces kept (small reports only). Default 5.

maxGB.description: Cap on the size of runs/ in GB, oldest first. Default 10.

minFreeGB.description: A gate or live scan refuses to start when the repo drive has less free space (after the pre-start prune). Default 20.

fastLane.description: Opt-in FAST LANE (deploy first, enforce after): a change whose diff from the last fully stamped commit touches only `allow`ed, non-denied paths may deploy on a permit before its heavy + predeploy run; that records one debt payable within deadlineHours. Not part of the stamp's config hash. Authoritative validation: plugin/scripts/predeploy/fastlane-rules.mjs.

allow.description: Globs (`**`, `*`, `?`, `{a,b}`; a pattern without `/` matches the file name at any depth) of paths that may ship ahead of the full run. Required and non-empty when enabled; a match-everything pattern is rejected; a path that matches nothing is never eligible.

deny.description: Extra deny globs. They only ADD to the built-in baseline (migrations, infra/deploy, auth/RLS, edge functions, dependency manifests, CI/gate config, secrets) and always beat `allow`.

deadlineHours.description: Hours the full heavy + predeploy run may trail a fast deploy. Default 12.

permitMinutes.description: How long a permit (and a multi-step deploy under it) stays valid. Default 60.

gateTiers.description: Gate tier names whose tree-bound pass stamp counts as "gate green". Default ["gate"].

github.description: Workflow file (push on the gate's predeploy/** tag namespace, no inputs) for remote-only checks; requires `why`.

prodPushIsDeploy.description: Default true: a `git push` to repo.prodBranch is recorded as a deploy (it creates live-scan debt). Set false when the push deploys nothing by itself (all targets are direct-upload, no git integration); the push is still verified against the stamp, only the deploy-ledger record (and so the live-scan debt) is skipped. The real deploy command is still recorded.

patterns.description: ADDITIONAL deploy patterns; the built-in baseline (wrangler, supabase db push/functions deploy, terraform apply, vercel --prod) always applies and an empty list is an error.

liveScan.description: Aggressive post-deploy ZAP active scan of the live targets. Guards: noRealCustomerCredentials + noPstnCalls (callOriginationExcludes).

exposure.description: Stack-exposure standard (D072, docs/stack-exposure.md). Required by default: a { preset: "stack-exposure" } check, or optOut.bundle naming a project decision. The live probes run with every liveScan unless optOut.live. Authoritative validation: plugin/scripts/predeploy/exposure-config.mjs.

forbiddenBody.description: Regexes no anonymous response body may match (internal hostnames, team names...).

deps.description: plugin extension (D064) — dependency freshness. New/changed dependencies must be at the latest release's major (0.x: minor): dep-version-guard hook, bash-guard install check, check-dep-freshness ci:fast gate. exceptions[] are decision-backed (each cites a D### that must exist in the decisions ledger; verified at run time, not by the schema).

name.description: Package name (dependency key or the target of an npm: alias).

range.description: Optional. The old spec being excepted; covers the same freshness bucket (same major, 0.x same minor). Omitted = any version of the package.

decision.description: Decision id in the decisions ledger that requires the old version.

why.description: Why the old version cannot be upgraded.

officeci.description: plugin extension (D073) — the OfficeCI coordinator that `gate-cli attest` verifies jobs against. Committed on purpose: a change is a reviewable diff, and editing maple.config.json asks for owner approval. Falls back to the OFFICECI_URL environment variable.

url.description: Coordinator base URL, e.g. http://host.tailnet.ts.net:8080 (no token here: that lives in OFFICECI_TOKEN / Credential Manager).

supabase.description: plugin extension (D065) — Supabase project refs for the MCP guard. Mutating Supabase MCP tools (apply_migration, execute_sql writes, deploy_edge_function, branch/project mutations) are denied unless tool_input.project_id is listed in devProjectRefs; a ref in prodProjectRefs is always denied; an unlisted ref is treated as production. The same lists drive prod-migration-guard (D074): `supabase db push` / `migration up|repair` against a ref that is not a dev ref needs an owner-issued approval.

devProjectRefs.description: Project refs of DEVELOPMENT projects (safe for MCP mutations).

prodProjectRefs.description: Project refs of PRODUCTION projects (never mutated through MCP). Optional: any unlisted ref is denied anyway; listing prod refs gives a sharper message.

security.description: plugin extension (D079-D086) — the security guardrail layer, see docs/security-guardrails.md. No block = every configurable control warns. credentialStore, secretShell and mcpSurface always enforce and are not configurable (D082).

enforceAfter.description: From this date on, warn acts as enforce. At most 30 days ahead.

necessity.description: New direct dependency needs a deps-ledger.json note (D086).

secretWrite.description: Secret scan of what Write/Edit adds.

gitHooks.description: gitleaks at commit, OSV + lockfile integrity at push.

continuous.description: Weekly re-scan of the deployed sha (D084).

writeGuard.description: write-scope-guard mode: off | warn (default: allow + notice) | deny. Env MAPLE_WRITE_GUARD overrides per session.

writeAllow.description: write-scope-guard: extra folders file-writing tools may write to, besides the project's repo (all its worktrees), the OS temp dirs and ~/.claude. Absolute, or relative to this file's folder.

linkGuardEnabled.description: link-guard: deny package installs into, and recursive deletes through, a node_modules that is a junction/symlink (a worktree linked to the main checkout). Default true.
